description: Search products, fetch full product details, reviews, questions, seller catalogs, categories, best sellers or deals across 18 MercadoLibre country sites.

categoryId.description: Category to browse or use as a filter (mode=search/categories/bestSellers/deals). Example: MLM1652.
categoryId.title: Category ID or URL

categoryQuery.description: Find matching categories from a keyword (mode=categories). Example: laptop.
categoryQuery.title: Category discovery keyword

fullShippingOnly.description: Keep products fulfilled by MercadoLibre FULL (mode=search/seller).
fullShippingOnly.title: MercadoLibre FULL only

includeAttributes.description: Attach the attribute schema to a category record (mode=categories with categoryId).
includeAttributes.title: Include category attributes

includeDetails.description: Fetch the full detail page for every search or seller result (mode=search/seller). Slower, more fields.
includeDetails.title: Enrich with product details

includeQuestions.description: Attach buyer questions and answers to product records (mode=product).
includeQuestions.title: Include questions

includeReviews.description: Attach review summary and review rows to product records (mode=product).
includeReviews.title: Include reviews

includeSellerProfile.description: Emit a seller profile row before the catalog (mode=seller).
includeSellerProfile.title: Include seller profile

includeSponsored.description: Include paid placements in search and seller results.
includeSponsored.title: Include sponsored products

maxItems.description: Maximum records to return. Product queries stop at the source's 2,000-row window.
maxItems.title: Maximum items

maxReviews.description: Maximum review rows per product (mode=reviews). Values above 330 sweep every rating bucket.
maxReviews.title: Maximum reviews

minDiscount.description: Keep products discounted by at least this percentage (mode=search/seller/deals). 0 disables it.
minDiscount.title: Minimum discount %

mode.description: Choose the kind of MercadoLibre data you need.
mode.title: What to scrape

officialStoresOnly.description: Keep products sold by official stores (mode=search/seller).
officialStoresOnly.title: Official stores only

priceMax.description: Highest price in the country currency (mode=search/seller). 0 means no maximum.
priceMax.title: Maximum price

priceMin.description: Lowest price in the country currency (mode=search/seller). 0 means no minimum.
priceMin.title: Minimum price

productUrls.description: Product, catalog or item URLs or IDs (mode=product/reviews/questions). One per line.
productUrls.title: Product URLs or IDs

reviewRating.description: Only collect reviews with this star rating (mode=reviews).
reviewRating.title: Review rating filter

searchQuery.description: Keyword to search for (mode=search). Example: laptop.
searchQuery.title: Search keywords

searchUrls.description: Paste MercadoLibre search, category or seller listing URLs (mode=search/seller). One per line.
searchUrls.title: Listing URLs

sellerId.description: Seller to catalog (mode=seller/search). Numeric ID, _CustId_ URL or seller_id URL.
sellerId.title: Seller ID or URL

sort.description: How to order search and seller results.
sort.title: Sort order

title: MercadoLibre Marketplace Scraper Input
